_source: in-game control options screen (your own settings)
globalAimNote: greyed out in the game while aimMode is custom
_cm360Note: Estimated turn distances at 1600 DPI. The trainer uses ADS multiplier = hipCm360 / adsCm360 for each magnification listed; others stay placeholders (1.0x multiplier / zoom).

model._comment: How aiming changes the view and the sensitivity. vFOV while aimed = hip vFOV * adsVFovMultipliers[magnification]. Magnifications not listed use 2*atan(tan(hipFov/2)/zoom) / hipFov. Sensitivity follows the same FOV every frame: multiplier = 1 + (adsMultiplier - 1) * p, where p = (tan(hip/2) - tan(current/2)) / (tan(hip/2) - tan(ads/2)) is how far the FOV has moved towards the aimed FOV (p = 1 when fully aimed, so the aimed sensitivity is exactly the one from adsCm360).
model.sensSliders: Horizontal / vertical sensitivity 1-50: degrees per count = sens x 0.00572958 (from your sens 7 at 1600 DPI = 14.25 cm/360). Vertical scales pitch only.
